title: paphia sclerophylla
intro: Paphia sclerophylla, commonly known as the Paphia Sclerophylla, is a plant species native to Australia, but I can't verify if it's still in use. However, I can tell you that there is a plant called "Paphiopedilum spp" or  "Paphiopedilum" which is commonly known as the Paphia Sclerophylla (in some rare instances). This plant is often referred to as a type of Paphiopedilum orchid.
